/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, tempfile, os, shutil
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

pptx = Path('/home/user/Desktop/181_2.pptx')
backup = pptx.with_suffix('.pptx.bak')
if not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(pptx, backup)

NS = {
    'p': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main',
    'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'p14': 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main',
    'p15': 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2012/main',
    'mc': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006',
}
for prefix, uri in NS.items():
    ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)

def q(tag):
    prefix, name = tag.split(':')
    return f'{{{NS[prefix]}}}{name}'

with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin:
    slide_xml = zin.read('ppt/slides/slide1.xml')
    root = ET.fromstring(slide_xml)
    cSld = root.find(q('p:cSld'))
    spTree = cSld.find(q('p:spTree'))

    # Replace or insert a slide-level solid purple background.
    old_bg = cSld.find(q('p:bg'))
    if old_bg is not None:
        cSld.remove(old_bg)
    bg = ET.Element(q('p:bg'))
    bgPr = ET.SubElement(bg, q('p:bgPr'))
    solid = ET.SubElement(bgPr, q('a:solidFill'))
    ET.SubElement(solid, q('a:srgbClr'), {'val': '800080'})
    ET.SubElement(bgPr, q('a:effectLst'))
    cSld.insert(0, bg)

    # Remove any previous APP textbox from a prior run, then add it once.
    for sp in list(spTree.findall(q('p:sp'))):
        cNvPr = sp.find(f\"{q('p:nvSpPr')}/{q('p:cNvPr')}\")
        if cNvPr is not None and cNvPr.get('name') == 'APP Note':
            spTree.remove(sp)

    max_id = 1
    for el in root.iter():
        if el.tag.endswith('cNvPr') and el.get('id'):
            try:
                max_id = max(max_id, int(el.get('id')))
            except ValueError:
                pass

    sp = ET.Element(q('p:sp'))
    nvSpPr = ET.SubElement(sp, q('p:nvSpPr'))
    ET.SubElement(nvSpPr, q('p:cNvPr'), {'id': str(max_id + 1), 'name': 'APP Note'})
    ET.SubElement(nvSpPr, q('p:cNvSpPr'), {'txBox': '1'})
    ET.SubElement(nvSpPr, q('p:nvPr'))
    spPr = ET.SubElement(sp, q('p:spPr'))
